subject.title: iOS app: push notifications for assistant messages + background Talk mode

question: Should native iOS assistant-message notifications use generic alerts only, allow transcript previews behind explicit opt-in, or remain unsupported until a broader mobile notification privacy model is approved?
rationale: The APNs registration, relay, and local notification pieces exist, but payload content, lock-screen privacy, tap routing, per-node opt-in semantics, and background audio policy require maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Approve generic chat alerts first
options.body: Add a dedicated assistant-reply APNs kind and iOS tap route with generic notification content by default, leaving transcript previews for a later explicit opt-in.

options.title: Allow opt-in transcript previews
options.body: Permit assistant reply text in APNs only behind a visible per-device or per-gateway privacy setting with tests and docs for lock-screen behavior.

options.title: Defer native chat pushes
options.body: Continue relying on foreground app state and third-party channels until maintainers define a broader mobile notification policy.

recommendation.title: Approve generic chat alerts first
recommendation.body: Add a dedicated assistant-reply APNs kind and iOS tap route with generic notification content by default, leaving transcript previews for a later explicit opt-in.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice is primarily product/privacy direction across iOS chat and Talk UX, where steipete has recent adjacent product-surface history.
